newsitem.title: USA: Medarex to acquire Houston Biotech.
newsitem.headline: Medarex to acquire Houston Biotech.

text.p: Medarex Inc said it tentatively agreed to acquire Houston Biotechnology Inc.

Medarex said it would issue 0.182 common share for each outstanding share of Houston Biotech HBI.A, a Houston, Texas-based biotechnology company that is developing monoclonal antibody and other biopharmaceutical products to prevent secondary cataract and to treat glaucoma, disorders that impair or destroy human vision.

Pending closing, Medarex said, it has agreed to fund the interim operations of Houston Biotech through a loan secured by a royalty-free license to commercialize its lead product for the prevention of secondary cataract.
With recent sales of Medarex common stock at $8.375 and 5,638,707 outstanding Houston Biotech common shares, the acquisition would have a market value of about $8.6 million.

Completion of the acquisition, which is expected in the first quarter 1997, is subject to the review by Medarex of the business and financial condition of Houston Biotech, the negotiation of a definitive agreement, the satisfaction of certain legal, accounting, and regulatory requirements, the approval of details of the transaction by the stockholders of Houston Biotech, and certain other matters.
